items.context: @CorySwan (305.992 seguidores), en inglés: "In a bear market, you pay in PRICE or you pay in TIME. I think there's more than a 50% chance Bitcoin makes a new all-time high in 2027." (video de su programa OUTSIDE MONEY: HIGHER LOWS). Publicado hace ~70 min: 2.726 vistas, 52 likes, 7 bookmarks, solo 4 respuestas. Ángulo: caídas y recuperación / ciclos.
items.suggested_text:
History backs the framing, and the two costs don't scale together. After the 2011 peak BTC fell 92.7% and took 622 days to reclaim the high. After 2013 the drop was smaller, 84.5%, yet the recovery took 1,177 days, almost twice as long. Shallower didn't mean faster.

This cycle is leaning hard on the time side: the downtrend is already past 411 days, the longest on record, with a drawdown milder than in earlier bears. That's a market wearing holders down through patience rather than panic.

The open question for any 2027 call is whether time can fully substitute for depth, or whether the market still asks for a bit of both before it moves on.
